text_block_list.text:
Having finished my work for the day, I was about to head home
when I heard voices arguing nearby.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Sirius,
I must ask you to cease your actions.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Leading a large group of students and occupying
the track time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Criticism against this has been mounting.
I understand you have your own principles,
but that is no excuse to hinder the growth of other students.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Alright, so say I step down from running things.
How do you plan to take care of them, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Regarding that,
I believe there is room for discussion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is a fact that the training of the students
gathered around you has fallen behind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, as a special period,
we plan to secure facilities and instructors
to carry out intensive training for them.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you're gonna solve it using that
textbook, royal-road method you love so much.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then I've got a question. What happens to the ones
who can't make it during that specific period?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In such cases,
we shall arrange another special opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: And what about the ones who can't make it to that either?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Likewise, we will provide the next opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Just as I thought!
They're just gonna keep slipping through the cracks!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Listen up, "Emperor."
You don't understand a single thing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Most people are born
with some kind of baggage.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Chronic illnesses, injuries, terrible family environments,
or severe financial struggles.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And problems like that hit out of nowhere.
Whether they've got races or training,
it doesn't give a damn.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In other words, unlike an honor student like you—
for them, there is no "next time."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So what matters is the "now." And you won't ever
see the "now" unless you look at them as individuals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... In essence, you are saying measures
must be tailored to each individual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is merit to that argument.
However, it is equally true that doing so is impractical.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If catering to individuals neglects the whole, it defeats the purpose.
Much less can we grant preferential treatment to only a fraction of students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, providing equal opportunity to all is
the best approach.

The debate between the two ran in parallel lines.
Just as I wondered how it would resolve—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Haah.
Talking any further with you is getting us nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you. You've been eavesdropping, haven't you?
Tell us who's right.
choice_data_list: Agree with Rudolf's stance prioritizing the whole
Agree with Sirius's stance prioritizing the individual

text_block_list.text:
Without keeping an eye on the whole, academy operations would crumble.
From my perspective as a Trainer, I agreed with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you share the perspective
of the administration too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I can't stand people lecturing me from above.
However—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...To shoot down my opinion head-on,
you've got quite the guts, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. Next time, I'll take you down along with her.
Right alongside that stiff over there.

Perhaps stating my mind clearly left a good impression;
Sirius Symboli walked away looking thoroughly satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, that's why I hate talking
to people in management.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Must be nice, just watching from the sidelines.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But when people are pushed into a corner,
there's no telling what they'll do.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...You'd better watch out
so the tables don't turn on you, alright?

A one-size-fits-all approach cannot solve individual problems.
I agreed with Sirius Symboli, who seeks to respect each person's needs.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so you get it.
Could it be that you're... on "our side" too?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Listen, "Emperor." You're not all-powerful.
You can't mesh with or understand distorted things.
—Why don't you just admit it already?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No. Even if that were true,
I want to continue making the effort to understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Naturally, that includes you as well, Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, is that so? Then first,
you'd better start by casting off that grandiose title of yours.

They were like oil and water. Yet the ideals lying ahead
shouldn't be so far apart. If they can only reach out to one another,
surely, someday—
